feature_metadata.name: IRRADIATION
feature_metadata.description: Global solar irradiance incident on solar panels.
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Primary physical driver of photovoltaic electron flow.

feature_metadata.name: AMBIENT_TEMPERATURE
feature_metadata.description: Surrounding ambient air temperature measured by meteorological station.
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Influences heat dissipation and ambient operating equilibrium.

feature_metadata.name: MODULE_TEMPERATURE
feature_metadata.description: Surface temperature of solar photovoltaic panel modules.
feature_metadata.operational_justification: PV panel efficiency decreases linearly as cell temperature rises above 25°C.

feature_metadata.name: temp_diff
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Direct measure of solar absorption heating above ambient.

feature_metadata.name: irr_mod_interaction
feature_metadata.description: Interaction product of IRRADIATION and MODULE_TEMPERATURE.
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Captures joint non-linear effect of peak sun exposure and thermal degradation.

feature_metadata.name: irr_amb_interaction
feature_metadata.description: Interaction product of IRRADIATION and AMBIENT_TEMPERATURE.

feature_metadata.name: irradiation_squared
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Models non-linear saturation curve of inverter clipping at high irradiance.

feature_metadata.name: sin_hour
feature_metadata.description: Sine cyclical encoding of time of day: sin(2 * pi * hour / 24).
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Provides smooth continuous representation of the 24-hour diurnal cycle.

feature_metadata.name: cos_hour
feature_metadata.description: Cosine cyclical encoding of time of day: cos(2 * pi * hour / 24).
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Provides perpendicular cyclical component to sin_hour.

feature_metadata.name: hour
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Allows tree splits on morning vs afternoon solar geometry.

feature_metadata.name: day_of_week
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Encodes potential weekly dispatch or maintenance rhythms.

feature_metadata.name: day_of_year
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Encodes seasonal solar declination and azimuth shifts.

feature_metadata.name: is_plant_2
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Encodes baseline capacity and hardware differences between Plant 1 and Plant 2.

feature_metadata.name: effective_irradiance
feature_metadata.description: Irradiance adjusted by PV thermal loss coefficient (-0.4%/°C above 25°C).
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Direct physical representation of actual usable solar flux after cell heating.

feature_metadata.name: solar_elevation_proxy
feature_metadata.description: Idealized solar elevation angle proxy based on daytime sine curve.
feature_metadata.operational_justification: Provides clean bell-shaped daylight geometric prior peaking at noon.
